fixtures: controlComp('quency', true) only — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / quency / helm (B3). quency is Burst II, so the fixed B3 (helm) is REQUIRED for the chain to reach Full Burst at all; helm=false would leave the comp with no Burst III and would not resolve the stage-2 contention anyway. She shares stage 2 with crown and casts on rotations where crown is on cooldown, so the burst suite opens with an explicit non-vacuity assertion (>=1 crit-rider batch) — if that fails, the finding is the fixture, not the override. 9 hoisted 180 s runs: base, skill1 duration 10->20, skill1 count 60->120, skill1 effects dropped, skill2 duration 5->10, skill2 value ->0, burst crit duration 10->15, burst crit dropped, burst Max HP dropped. Every counterfactual is damage-only (burst gauge is per-shot and damage-independent), so all patched runs share the base run's rotation timeline and expiresFrame deltas are exact.
gaps: skill1 basis (it.skip): 'Duplicates 12.42% of the Max HP of the Nikke with the highest Max HP' has NO matching StatKey — the schema offers highestAllyAtkPct for ATK but no highest-ally Max HP analogue. caster/targetMaxHpPct on a self target is exact only when quency herself holds the team's highest Max HP; the divergence is unassertable without a new primitive. (Damage-inert today either way, so it is a completeness gap, not an accuracy gap.)

skill1 hit-count unit (it.skip, ⚑): 'after 60 normal attacks' is ambiguous between ROUNDS and trigger pulls on a 2-rounds-per-pull SMG (120-round magazine). The engine convention is rounds (60 = half a magazine / 30 pulls); the pulls reading would need count:120. Not prose-decidable — the test pins 60 per engine convention and flags the alternative.

skill2 trigger identity + cadence (it.skip, ⚑): the line carries no 'Activates when/after' clause, so per repo convention it is interval{sec: datamined skill cooldown} — and that cooldown is NOT in this packet (the supplied 'cd 20s' is the BURST cooldown). Cadence is datamine/measurement-gated; only 'repeats >=2 times over 180 s' is asserted.

PACKET DEFECT (reported, not acted on): the packet documents two contradictory override shapes — the harness cheat-sheet says each slot is a CharacterSkills with its own blocks[] (patch ov.skill1!.blocks), the OVERRIDE FILE SHAPE section says each slot IS a Block[] (iterate override.skill1). The test carries a blocksOf() resolver that handles both and mutates nested objects in place, so it is shape-agnostic; the source docs should be reconciled.

Ranking semantics byFinalAtk (structural-only): scope-lock ATK is class-based and the control comp's three Supporters tie, so no behavioural counterfactual in this fixture can distinguish live-ATK from static-ATK ranking. Pinned structurally against the kit's literal 'final ATK' wording instead.
